content.title: Expedia Group (EXPE) Is Up 17.4% After Raising Revenue Outlook on Strong Q3 Results
content.summary: Expedia Group reported strong third-quarter 2025 results, posting US$4.41 billion in sales and US$959 million in net income, and raised its full-year revenue guidance to 6%-7% growth, up from the previous 3%-5% range. The company also declared a US$0.40 per share quarterly dividend and highlighted continued double-digit growth in both bookings and B2B operations compared to the prior year. content.title: The Score: GM, Tesla, Palantir, American Airlines and More Stocks That Defined the Week
content.summary: Trade-sensitive stocks rose Wednesday as the Supreme Court heard oral arguments on the case challenging the broad array of global tariffs President Trump has imposed.  The levies appeared to be on shaky ground after the hearing, during which justices expressed skepticism about Trump’s authority to impose sweeping measures on countries around the world.  The Trump administration’s top lawyer faced sharp questioning, including from some members of the court’s conservative wing.
